content: We use the siamese architecture to encode both the premise ( $p_{1:m}$ ) and hypothesis ( $h_{1:n}$ ) following the standard of sentence-encoding models in the literature. (Specifically, $p_{1:m}$ is encoded as $\check{\mathbf {h}}_\text{root}^p \in \mathbb {R}^{d_h}$ and $h_{1:n}$ is encoded as $\check{\mathbf {h}}_\text{root}^h \in \mathbb {R}^{d_h}$ with the same encoder.)
